That feels right for a brand-new start. When there's nothing saved yet, there's nothing to search through or filter, so hiding the search box and the label chips keeps the screen from looking cluttered with controls that wouldn't do anything. What's left is one clear "No bookmarks yet" message and an obvious "Add your first bookmark" button, which tells me exactly what to do first without any guesswork.

I'd just take it as given that once I've actually saved something, all those browsing tools — search, labels, and the rest — come back so I can use them. On that understanding, yes, this empty starting screen is what I'd want.
